# Curated Day 3 figures

**12 model-prediction comparisons:** `Day3_WB_Prediction_img_*.png`. Each figure contains original RGB, COCO WB ground truth and WB-only YOLOv8n-seg predictions, generated by Khang on 12 selected images. These are **not all 450 test images**. See `09_results/reports/Day3_WB_Qualitative_Review_2026-11-03.md` and `09_results/wb_error_analysis/` for matching statistics.

**4 area examples:** `Day3_Area_*.png`, generated by Thịnh from a separately sampled 30-image test subset. Each includes GT, predictions, and an illustrative crop showing mask area in **px²**. See `09_results/area_evaluation/area_findings.md` for metrics and selection.

Caution: `004252.png` and `004472.png` have **suspected** GT annotation anomalies (not verified against raw polygon data). The original M18K imagery's redistribution terms have not yet been confirmed; review permission before public publication of these figures.
